meaning:
λυμαίνομαι
(λύμη, outrage), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת pi., hi., also for כִּרְסֵם, etc. ;]
1. to outrage, maltreat: with accusative, Act.8:3.
2. to corrupt, defile (Eze.16:25, Pro.23:8, 4Ma.18:8, al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
